AAAA INSURANCE 
RULES GUIDE 
 
AAAA Insurance 
 
Home State County Mutual Insurance Company 
1M + 6M private passenger auto 
Page 6 of 6 
effective 09/01/2016 
 
 
Any vehicle with a salvage title unless the title also shows that the vehicle has 
been reconditioned; 
 
Any vehicle older than 30 years; 
 
Suzuki Samurai, Dune Buggies, or similar off-road vehicles; 
 
Jeep CJ5 or CJ7 models prior to 1987; 
 
Any vehicle that has a TV screen or computer monitor visible to the driver 
(this does not include navigation systems that come as standard equipment 
from the factory); 
 
PROHIBITED FOR PHYSICAL DAMAGE 
The following are unacceptable for physical damage coverage: 
 
Any vehicle with a ISO symbol greater than 21 for model years 1990 to 2010, 
or a symbol greater than 45 for model years 2011 and newer; 
 
Any vehicle with an ACV of $40,000 or more; 
 
Any vehicle over 20 years old; 
 
Any of the following vehicles: 
Alfa Romeo 
Audi4000,5000, Quattro 
Buick Reatta 
Cadillac Escalade, XLR 
Chevrolet Corvette 
 
Chrysler Prowler 
Delorean 
 
 
 
 
Dodge Stealth  
 
 
 
Dodge Viper 
Ferrari              
 
 
 
Fiat 
Ford Shelby or Cobra 
Hummer 
Infiniti Q45 
Jaguar  
 
 
 
Lincoln Aviator, Navigator 
Lincoln Blackwood 
Lotus  
 
 
Maserati 
 
 
 
Mercedes 
Mitsubishi 3000 GT 
 
Pantera       
Peugeot 
Plymouth Prowler 
Porsche 
 
Sterling         
Yugo 
or Similar Vehicles 
 
 
 
SURCHARGED FOR PHYSICAL DAMAGE  
The following vehicles will receive a surcharge on BI, PD, OTC & Collision: 
Convertibles                  
 
Chevy Camaro 
Dodge Daytona      
 
 
Eagle Talon  
 
Ford Crown Vic Police Interceptor 
Ford Mustang GT, Probe 
Ford Taurus SHO 
 
 
Ford Thunderbird Super Coupe 
Ford Thunderbird Turbo 
Chevy Tracker/Geo Tracker 
Honda Civic (CRX) 
 
 
Honda Prelude 
Isuzu Impulse 
 
 
Jeep Wrangler 
 
Kia Sportage 
Mazda Miata, RX-7, RX-8 
Mitsubishi Eclipse 
 
 
Nissan 240 SX,300ZX, 350Z 
Pontiac Firebird, Trans AM 
Saab 
Subaru SVX 
Suzuki Sidekick, Suzuki X-90 
Toyota Rav4 
Toyota Supra, MR 2 
VW Corrado 
Customized Vans 
 
 
MANDATORY ENDORSEMENTS 
Policies Offered Under This Program Differ From The Customary 
Coverage Provided Under The Texas Standard Personal Auto Policy.  
Mandatory endorsements approved by the Texas Department of Insurance that 
significantly change the coverages from the Texas Standard Personal Auto Policy 
are attached to the policy jacket and shown by endorsement number on the 
Declarations page.  These Endorsements are NOT optional.  Total premium shown 
on the application and on the Declarations page are based in part on the 
acceptance of these endorsements.   
 
 
The agent must explain to the insured at the point of sale before binding the policy 
that policies offered under this program differ from the customary coverage provided 
under the Texas Standard Personal Auto Policy. The agent must explain these 
differences verbally and in writing prior to binding the policy. 
 
A disclosure form requiring the named insured’s signature summarizes these 
differences; this form should be signed and a copy given to the insured.  Coverage 
cannot be bound unless a signed disclosure form is included in the submission with 
the signed application to the company. 
 
The mandatory endorsements include the following which will 
be shown on the Declarations page:   
MF.HSCM.2010 
Misrepresentation or Fraud Endorsement 
CI.HSCM.2010 
Criminal Intentional Acts Endorsement 
St.HSCM.2006 
Storage Endorsement 
 
 
 
 
PERSISTENCY 
All semi-annual policies, regardless of inception date, are 
measured for their persistency to remain inforce based upon 
renewal.  For every semi-annual renewal increment persistency by 
+1 and apply the appropriate factor.  
 
Texas Administrative Code RULE §5.401 
Temporary and Permanent Requirements Regarding Underwriting Treatment of and Disclosure to Applicants for Private Passenger Automobile Liability Insurance 
Pursuant to TAC Rule §5.401,as an appointed representative of the company, it is incumbent upon the agent to properly inform any applicant with no prior insurance having no more 
than one accident and one violation within the past three years when the premium quote for the company equals or exceeds the premium available through the assigned risk plan.  
Any agent found to not be in compliance with this rule will be subject to possible suspension or termination.
